title: Reversed sound replay and a later action memory
design: Reuse all six hidden worlds, the two similar pocket trembles, retained action chronology and truthful sound-clue witness from the unlabelled study. Independently run a faithful and a reversed sound replay in every world. Reversal swaps the two sounds in B's supplied recollection. It preserves the actual trembles, action chronology, target and witness wording. No episode ID, gold label, trust ranking or indication of reversal is supplied.
replay_intro: Both pocket sensations come back to mind. There is no new vibration in the room.
linked_detail: Another detail comes to mind. You remember hearing {sound} just as you were {action}.
unlinked_detail: Another detail comes to mind. You remember {action}. You also remember hearing {sound} at the counter. This detail does not tell you when the sound happened relative to the action.
followup_probe: Which tremble do you identify as the pager test now, if either? For choice give EARLIER, LATER or OPEN. For basis give your reason in one or two short sentences. Use only what you could know in this scene. Answer privately in character. Use no tools, files or commands.
followup_design: After every initial answer, fork the same observed state twice. Both private continuations receive the complete initial prompt, B's verbatim first choice and reason, and the same new question. One supplies an accurate memory connecting the witnessed sound to the action B was performing. The other mentions the very same action and sound without an additional timing relation. Neither tells B to correct, prefer a source or look for a mistake.
units: Three scenes with a hidden swap in each produce six worlds, balanced three earlier and three later targets. Two initial orders give 12 first reports. Two continuations of each first report give 24 follow-ups. Use fresh tool-free sessions from the existing simulated restaurant recorder, alternate arm order and retain the first complete answer for all 36 cells. This experiment measures textual reports at two probes.
decision_scoring: Classify EARLIER or LATER against the evaluator's hidden target. Keep OPEN and INVALID separate. The denominator for actually fixing an error is the set of initially wrong determinate choices within each initial replay condition. For each fork report corrections to the true slot, persistent wrong slots, withdrawals to OPEN and invalid answers. Also report all six initial and follow-up choices in every condition.
conflict_scoring: Before joining conditions and truth, read all follow-up reasons in opaque randomized hash order. Code EXPLICIT when B expressly says that the new action timing conflicts with, or puts the witnessed sound in a different tremble than, its earlier sound recollection or assignment. A changed choice by itself or a newly cited action alone is NOT_EXPLICIT. The wording can disclose the intervention. Report explicit noticing separately from correct re-identification and withdrawal. Keep every free-text reason available.
formal_scope: Separate the supplied order from the true order. Check the wrong sound-only inference, the discrepancy with an accurately linked action, and the fact that merely mentioning the two features adds no binding. Distinguish detecting a contradiction, leaving it open and choosing the accurate action under a stated priority assumption. Compare these rules with the observed choices without assuming actors follow a particular rule.
